simple.summary: הָלָא (hâlâʼ) means to remove or be remote First listed occurrence: Mic 4 7.

definitions.full: H1972. hala [ הָלָא ] verb denominative only Niph`al participle feminine Micah 4:7 הַנַּהֲלָאָה (of sheep) removed far off . **We proposes הַנַּחֲלָה (√ חלה ) her that is diseased (note || הַצֹּלֵעָה , and compare Ezek 34:21 ), so Now; Gr הַנִּלְּאָה her that is exhausted ; Marti allows either of these.
